proposed.title: Thor: The Dark World
proposed.text: To help Thor smuggle Jane out of Asgard against Odin's orders, Heimdall summons Odin to the Bifrost and confesses to treason to keep him distracted.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Heimdall's king, to whom he confesses treason to cover Thor's escape.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Guardian of the Bifrost, who confesses treason to Odin to cover Thor's escape.

changes.evidence: Thor: The Dark World: Heimdall agrees to help Thor's secret plan, calls Odin to Himinbjorg on an 'urgent matter' and confesses 'Treason, my lord... Mine' while the others break Loki and Jane out.

proposed.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
proposed.text: After Jane dies, Heimdall welcomes her to Valhalla and thanks her for helping save his son.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Asgard's watchman, who welcomes Jane to Valhalla after she dies.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Thor's love, whom Heimdall welcomes to Valhalla.

changes.evidence: Thor: Love and Thunder post-credits scene: the dead Jane arrives in Valhalla and Heimdall greets her ('Welcome to Valhalla'), thanking her for helping save his son Axl.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: When Tony dies after using the Stones to destroy Thanos and his army, Rhodey is at his side, and he later mourns him at the funeral.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Rhodes's best friend, at whose side he kneels as he dies.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's best friend, at his side as he dies.

changes.evidence: Avengers: Endgame: War Machine lands beside the dying Iron Man after the snap, holds him in his final moments, then attends his funeral.

proposed.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
proposed.text: Ultron attacks J.A.R.V.I.S., who survives by hiding inside the internet. Tony and Bruce then upload him into the synthetic body that becomes Vision.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Uploads what is left of J.A.R.V.I.S. into the body that becomes Vision.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The AI Tony creates, uploaded into Vision's body after Ultron's attack.

changes.evidence: Avengers: Age of Ultron: Ultron 'eliminates Stark's AI J.A.R.V.I.S.'; 'Stark and Banner upload J.A.R.V.I.S., who has been secretly active inside the Internet to hide from Ultron, into the synthetic body.'

proposed.title: VisionQuest#1
proposed.text: Years later J.A.R.V.I.S. lives inside the White Vision's Mindspace, where he looks after the household and helps Vision learn to fit in among people.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The synthezoid whose Mindspace J.A.R.V.I.S. looks after.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An AI in Vision's Mindspace, who looks out for him like an older brother.

changes.evidence: VisionQuest episode 1 'No Strings': inside Vision's Mindspace he resides with J.A.R.V.I.S., F.R.I.D.A.Y. and other AIs who help him improve his social interaction; J.A.R.V.I.S. oversees security and housekeeping there and acts as an older-brother figure.

proposed.title: VisionQuest#2
proposed.text: When Paladin's adamantium rounds leave Vision dying, J.A.R.V.I.S. deletes his own program to reroute power and save him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The synthezoid J.A.R.V.I.S. gives his life to save.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An AI in Vision's Mindspace, who deletes himself to save him.

changes.evidence: VisionQuest episode 2 'Theseus': Paladin mortally wounds Vision; 'J.A.R.V.I.S. sacrifices himself by deleting his own program to reroute power and save Vision and the other AIs.' Episode 3 shows his funeral.

proposed.title: Iron Man 2
proposed.text: When Vanko takes over Rhodes's War Machine armor at the Stark Expo, Natasha, undercover at Stark Industries, breaks into Hammer's system and gives him back control.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Undercover S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who gives Rhodes back control of his armor.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: War Machine, whose armor Natasha frees from Vanko's control.

changes.evidence: Iron Man 2: Vanko takes remote control of the drones and Rhodes's armor; 'Romanoff gains access to Hammer Industries software and returns control of Rhodes's armor to him.'

proposed.title: Avengers: Infinity War
proposed.text: Rhodes defies Ross to stand with the Avengers and pushes to get Vision somewhere safe from Thanos. He fights to defend Vision in Wakanda, but Thanos tears the Mind Stone from his head.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An ally again, whom Rhodes fights to protect in Wakanda.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An ally again, who fights to protect Vision in Wakanda.

changes.evidence: Avengers: Infinity War: Rhodes argues with Ross that Vision would be safe but for the Accords, urges the team to get somewhere safe to protect Vision, and fights in the Battle of Wakanda until Thanos crushes his armor and rips the Stone from Vision.

proposed.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
proposed.text: Pulled into the Quantum Realm, Janet finally confesses to Hope and Hank the secret she kept from them: she once helped Kang rebuild his power core, then turned on him and left him trapped there.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Hope's mother, who confesses she kept her past with Kang a secret.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Janet's daughter, to whom she finally confesses her past with Kang.

changes.evidence: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania: aboard Krylar's ship, Janet confesses to Hope and Hank that she met Kang, helped him repair his power core, then turned against him and enlarged the core beyond use.

proposed.title: Thor
proposed.text: Jasper Sitwell serves under Phil Coulson at the S.H.I.E.L.D. site around Mjolnir in New Mexico, and warns him when Thor breaks in.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Sitwell's commander at the Mjolnir site in New Mexico.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An agent under Coulson at the Mjolnir site, who warns him of Thor's break-in.

changes.evidence: Thor: Sitwell is reassigned to New Mexico under Coulson, heads the lab studying the hammer, warns Coulson of Thor's breach, and later asks him about the Destroyer.

now.title: Agent Carter S1
now.text: Jack Thompson leads the SSR manhunt for Howard Stark when Howard is accused of selling his weapons.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Fugitive Jack hunts. Once cleared, makes Jack praise him in public.

changes.evidence: Stage 0's card line on Jack's card ('Once cleared, makes Jack praise him in public') gives away the press conference that is its own later stage (Agent Carter S1#8); it is a copy of stage 1's line.
